semantics: Fixed visual review taxonomy. Scenario observations are proposals; the independent rule registry controls automatic public-clause and explicitly user-provided workplace-policy findings. No example video, filename, timestamp or verdict is included.

scenarios.label: Personal belongings at the workplace: food on the cashier work table

check_descriptions.food_item_visually_identified: A food item or snack is clearly identifiable; an ambiguous package, unknown cup contents, empty wrapper, medicine, cash or work equipment is insufficient.
check_descriptions.food_on_cashier_work_surface: The identified food is visibly on the cashier work table or work surface. Food presence qualifies without eating, chewing or hand-to-mouth motion.
check_descriptions.workstation_work_context_visible: The relevant surface is visibly an operating cashier workstation with staff work activity; a break room or unresolved nonworking context does not qualify.
check_descriptions.relevant_context_visible: Readable source-referenced views establish the food item, its location on the work surface and the operating workstation context; a consumption sequence is not required.

unknowns: Food presence on the operating cashier work table is the target; eating and personal ownership need not be observed.
Ambiguous containers, unknown cup contents, empty wrappers, medicine and work equipment must not be called food.
Cashier workstation and working context require visible support; break areas and actual shift schedules are not inferred.
The prohibition is a user-provided workplace policy, not a verified public-law clause.

scenarios.label: Cash remains exposed across a client-service transition

check_descriptions.cash_on_work_surface_observed: A cash-like bundle or notes are visibly outside a storage container.
check_descriptions.client_service_transition_observed: The supplied sequence shows a client arrival/departure or another distinct service transition.
check_descriptions.cash_persistence_visually_supported: The same visible cash location or bundle persists across the observed transition; no identity is inferred across occlusion.

unknowns: Cash ownership and actual transaction completion require separate context verification.
Several piles alone do not establish earlier-client cash.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019

scenarios.label: Cash placement and storage concern

check_descriptions.cash_handling_observed: A visible cash-like bundle is handled at the workstation.
check_descriptions.storage_relationship_visible: The sequence shows the cash location relative to a visible drawer, cabinet, safe or work surface.

unknowns: A still-open drawer does not establish an always-locked requirement.
Storage purpose, prior cash lineage and interval completeness may remain unknown.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019

scenarios.label: Cash handling while the visible client area is empty

check_descriptions.cash_acceptance_or_count_observed: Acceptance or manual/machine counting of visible cash-like notes is observed.
check_descriptions.client_area_visible: The relevant client side of the workstation is actually visible.
check_descriptions.client_absence_visually_supported: No client is visible in the adequately exposed relevant client area at the observed cash action.

unknowns: A camera crop or occluded client area is not evidence of absence.
Cash stock preparation is not established client intake.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019

scenarios.label: Cash-processing activity requiring control-context review

check_descriptions.cash_processing_observed: Visible counting, sorting or packing of cash-like notes is observed.
check_descriptions.processing_area_visible: The supplied views expose the immediate processing area and visible accompanying persons.

unknowns: Client intake and payout are excepted from this particular control rule.
People count, clothes or appearance do not establish supervisory roles or authorization.
An unobserved controller is not proven absent.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019

scenarios.label: Visible handling or placement of keys and stamps

check_descriptions.key_or_stamp_visually_supported: A key-like item or stamp is visually identifiable; unresolved tiny objects stay unknown.
check_descriptions.handling_or_placement_observed: The sequence shows its handling, transfer or placement on a visible surface or container.

unknowns: An actual internal bank policy and access records are needed to determine a safeguard breach.
A surface placement alone is not a universal legal violation.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019

scenarios.label: Cash arrangement or transfer at vault or safe storage

check_descriptions.storage_container_visible: A safe, cabinet or storage container and its relevant opening or compartment is visible.
check_descriptions.cash_storage_relationship_observed: Cash-like notes or bundles are visibly placed, removed or arranged relative to that storage.

unknowns: Vault classification, bank/client cash identity and any required segregation policy remain unknown.
No exact public clause mapping has been curated for this category; the visual concern is review-only.

scenarios.label: Personal-object candidate in a cash-handling area

check_descriptions.non_cash_object_visually_supported: A bag, phone, personal container or other non-cash object is visually identifiable.
check_descriptions.object_cash_area_relationship_visible: Its placement or handling in the visible cash-handling workstation is supported.

unknowns: Appearance does not establish personal ownership, contents or prohibited purpose.
Medicines, medical devices and qualifying communication devices have exceptions.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019

scenarios.label: Workstation departure requiring intake-context review

check_descriptions.actual_workstation_departure: A person visibly moves outside the workstation rather than standing or reaching within it.

unknowns: An empty chair alone is insufficient.
Active unfinished client intake must be separately established.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019

scenarios.label: Payout handover requiring count-sequence review

check_descriptions.cash_handover_observed: A visible cash-like bundle or notes are passed toward another person or the client side.
check_descriptions.cash_form_visible: The supplied view exposes whether the item resembles loose notes, a wrapped pack or unresolved packaging.

unknowns: Sparse samples cannot prove a counting step was omitted.
Packaging exceptions, earlier counting and offscreen counting require complete context.

legal_source.document: NBK Board Resolution No. 231 of 29 November 2019
